title: Treatment menu time tab lock
body:
If you start entering time in the time tab of the treatment menu, you can go to another tab before finishing.
If you do that, you will never be able to submit the form.
As long as you do not enter a valid time on the time tab or delete it completely, the green checkmark will not appear and you will not be able to submit.

It makes sense to expect a valid time entry.  But, users post on facebook asking why they cannot enter treatments.  It turns out they have accidentally entered a value on the time tab.

We need to come up with some sort of sign or symbol or note to highlight this to help the user.
